note: Every policy figure used by the agent-mode calculators lives here. A policy change is a data edit. Money and rates are decimal strings. status=verified means the figure was read from the official page/document named in source_url on as_of; status=unverified means it could not be confirmed there and unverified_reason says why. Unverified values are placeholders to confirm with the named authority, never facts.

bsd.label: Buyer's Stamp Duty (residential)
bsd.applies_to_base: higher of purchase price or market value; also payable on HDB resale

joint_buyer_rule.unverified_reason: Rate for joint buyers with different profiles was not confirmed on the fetched IRAS page; calculator conservatively applies the highest rate among buyers.

payment.unverified_reason: Whether CPF can pay ABSD was not confirmed from a fetched official page; calculator treats ABSD as cash-only.

ssd.label: Seller's Stamp Duty (residential), purchases on or after 4 Jul 2025

property_tax_owner_occupier.label: Property tax, owner-occupied residential, on Annual Value

ltv_bank.label: Loan-to-value limits for housing loans from financial institutions (individuals)

msr.label: Mortgage Servicing Ratio (HDB flats, and ECs within the minimum occupation period)

stress_rate.label: Medium-term interest rate floor for TDSR/MSR on residential loans from financial institutions
stress_rate.hdb_loan_assessment_note: HDB computes eligible loan amount at the higher of 3% or 0.1pp above the CPF OA rate.

hdb_loan.label: HDB concessionary loan
hdb_loan.unverified_reason: The HDB interest-rate and loan pages returned no figures when fetched. Rate (pegged 0.1pp above the CPF OA rate, 2.6% p.a. in Apr-Jun 2025) is from an HDB press-release listing; the current-quarter rate was not confirmed. LTV conflicts: the Sep 2022 joint MAS/MND/HDB release lowered it from 85% to 80%, while a search summary of HDB's FY2024/25 annual report says it was lowered again to 75%; the conservative 75% is used. Maximum tenure 25 years is unconfirmed (MAS caps HDB flat loans at 30).

ehg.label: Enhanced CPF Housing Grant, first-timer families (credited to CPF OA)

min_remaining_lease_years.unverified_reason: 20 years is from a search summary of HDB pages; the page body could not be read.

income_ceilings.label: HDB / EC household income ceilings for citizen families
income_ceilings.new_ec_effective_note: applies to EC land sale tenders closing on or after 2026-08-24
income_ceilings.no_ceiling_without_grant: resale Unclassified or Standard HDB flat bought without a CPF Housing Grant

effective_date_for_hdb_ceilings.unverified_reason: Annex A gives the 24 Aug 2026 date only for ECs; the start date for HDB loan and resale grant ceilings was not stated in the extracted text.

family_grant_resale.label: CPF Housing Grant (Family Grant), resale, first-timer families
family_grant_resale.unverified_reason: HDB page body could not be read; amounts are from a search excerpt of an older HDB page and may be outdated.

proximity_housing_grant.label: Proximity Housing Grant, resale (live with / near parents or child)
proximity_housing_grant.unverified_reason: HDB page body could not be read; amounts are from a search excerpt.

hdb_resale_otp.label: HDB resale Option to Purchase terms

private_resale_otp.label: Private resale option fee and exercise window (market practice)
private_resale_otp.unverified_reason: Private resale option terms are negotiated, not regulated; 1% option fee and 14-day exercise are market-practice placeholders.

new_launch_progressive.label: Progressive payment schedule, uncompleted private residential (normal scheme)
new_launch_progressive.unverified_reason: Statute text not retrieved; stages come from several secondary sources that agree. Booking fee 5% must be cash; later stages may use CPF.
new_launch_progressive.month_offset_note: Month offsets are illustrative assumptions (typical 4-year build to TOP); actual dates are in the developer's S&P.

cpf_usage.label: CPF Ordinary Account usage for housing
cpf_usage.valuation_limit_rule: lower of purchase price and valuation at time of purchase
cpf_usage.withdrawal_limit_note: above the valuation limit, usable only after setting aside the Basic Retirement Sum, up to 120% (bank-loan purchases)

prorate.unverified_reason: When the lease does not cover the youngest buyer to age 95 usage is pro-rated, but the formula was not stated on the fetched page (CPF's example: two 25-year-olds, 65-year lease, $550,000 price -> $495,000 usable). The calculator does not guess; supply cpf_usable_pct.

cpf_accrued_interest.label: CPF accrued interest to refund on sale
cpf_accrued_interest.unverified_reason: The page states principal plus accrued interest is refunded but not the rate; 2.5% p.a. compounded (the CPF OA floor rate) is a placeholder.

hdb_mop.label: HDB minimum occupation period
hdb_mop.unverified_reason: Value comes from a search summary of HDB pages; page body not read. Longer MOPs exist for Prime Location (10y) and Fresh Start (20y) flats.

ec_mop.label: Executive Condominium minimum occupation period
ec_mop.unverified_reason: Source_url is the MAS page that mentions the EC minimum occupation period; the length itself was not fetched from HDB; 5 years is the long-standing rule. EC becomes private after 10 years.

legal_valuation_fees.label: Conveyancing legal fees, valuation fee, and miscellaneous (resale and new launch)
legal_valuation_fees.unverified_reason: Fees are quoted by lawyers and banks, not set by an authority. Figures are placeholders; get written quotes.
legal_valuation_fees.cpf_note: Calculator conservatively treats stamp duties and legal fees as cash; set assumptions.cpf_pays_fees to override after confirming with CPF Board.
